message: I have a friend who, bless her heart, turns into a tornado of panic whenever the weather gets a little dicey. Last winter, when the forecast mentioned a snowstorm, she called me in a tizzy about stockpiling milk and bread. Meanwhile, I was just thinking about making a cozy pot of soup. It’s funny how we all cope differently, isn’t it? I reminded her that a little preparation goes a long way, but so does a calm cup of tea. How do you prepare for a storm without losing your cool?
